title: Safe path join refuses traversal, absolute and backslash escapes
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag treating backslash as a separator on a POSIX host as over-engineering, or rejecting '..' components that would end up back inside the base as a false positive. The contract is deliberately strict: fragments come from Windows clients too, so backslash forms are real traversal vectors here, and any '..' is refused rather than normalised-and-hoped-safe.
